title: Flip Mosaic
description: Two-sided image tiles with eight focused controls for musical flips, floating motion and surface reflections.

parameters.label: Tile Count
parameters.description: Tiles along the shorter image side.

parameters.label: Beat Tiles
parameters.description: Share of tiles selected by a strong accent.

parameters.label: Flip Time
parameters.description: Combined outward and return time in seconds. Higher values turn more slowly.

parameters.label: Tile Float
parameters.description: Combined tile drift and rise/fall depth; responds to sound energy.

parameters.label: Float Speed
parameters.description: Continuous travel of the floating motion and reflections.

parameters.label: Reflections
parameters.description: Soft light moving across the tile surfaces.

parameters.label: Note Response
parameters.description: Include softer instrumental attacks in tile turns.

provenance.prompt_summary: Two-sided image tiles with eight focused controls for musical flips, floating motion and surface reflections.
